title: Figure 33: Takeoff and landing speeds of minimum-sized launchers vs. weight ratio
description: Scatter plot of takeoff speed (knots, 0-500) versus weight ratio to orbital speed (2.00-9.00), with pink squares for "FDL-7, TO," green triangles for "+SBW, TO" and blue diamonds for "+SWB, LND" (switchblade wing takeoff and landing). Caption: "Figure 33. Takeoff and Landing Speeds of Minimum-Sized Launchers." Appears under the heading "Up-and-Down Operations."
